title: Lazar's leak as a planned counterintelligence release

tellings.quote: So they give it to somebody whose reputation is is really not that good.

related.note: Both explain how Lazar's S-4 story got out as an intelligence move around 1988-89. The story says Lazar was pushed out after Lear gave files to Knapp; this telling says the leak was a planned release through someone with a poor reputation. These are competing core claims about the same event.

plain: The UFO researcher Grant Cameron suggests that the secrets Bob Lazar went public with in 1988 and 1989 may have been a planned release by intelligence officials, not a true leak. Lazar is a man who said he worked on alien craft at a secret site in Nevada. In Cameron's view, the officials wanted the information out but deniable: "So they give it to somebody whose reputation is really not that good." Cameron offers this as his own reading and names no source.
